content:
ravi: After the 02:00 UTC deploy (release-4.0.2) embeddings p95 in ap-south jumped 80ms -> 950ms. Seen across multiple pods. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/embeds/ap-south

deploybot: deploybot: Alert: embeddings.p95@ap-south > 900ms. Autorevert: enabled but blocked by change-window. Suggested: staged pin or tenant reroute.

mei: traces show kv cache miss bursts and one big batch from tenant 'beta-inc'. Could be client amplification.

zack: can we route that tenant off the new release? `redwood route update --tenant beta-inc --route embeddings --to release-4.0.1 --now`

ops-lead: do tenant reroute first. If whole region stays bad after 15m, plan a night rollback at 23:45 UTC. Ravi, authorize a 1h regional pin as fallback.

ravi: authorizing region pin. Running: `redwood pin set --region ap-south --route embeddings --version release-4.0.1 --duration 1h`

deploybot: deploybot: Tenant route applied for beta-inc. Region pin applied by ravi at 2026-04-02T02:07:45Z. Monitoring.

mei: pinned slice p95 ~160ms. Tenant route fixed beta-inc latency. Other tenants stable so far.

claire: I'll draft a short CS blurb: "We routed impacted customer traffic to a stable release to reduce latency. We're investigating root cause and will update."

ops-lead: owners: Ravi (pin), Mei (root cause), Claire (customer comms), Zack (rollback prep). If p95 >300ms for >15m after pin expiry, rollback to 4.0.1 at 23:45 UTC.

ravi: noted. Ticket INF-7801 opened with traces and commands. Keeping thread open until resolved.
